title: running a 2 week jam for AI-built games and apps, $1,000 in cash prizes, entering is free
author: IamDroBro
selftext:
hey all, im the guy building whim (the marketplace for vibe-coded apps and games from my launch post). the launch went way better than expected and the most common question was "how do i get people to actually see my stuff". so im putting money where my mouth is.



whim jam #1. two tracks, best game and best app, so youre not competing against a budgeting tool with your roguelike. $400 to each track winner, $200 to the community favorite, and winners get a month featured on the homepage.



rules are short: built with AI assistance (obviously), published on whim between aug 17 and aug 30, browser playable preferred. free or paid, your call, and you keep 90% of anything you sell during the jam. first listing is free so entering literally costs nothing. paid entries can attach a free demo build now too, so people can try before buying.



already have something half built? finish it and enter it. thats completely fine, this isnt one of those "must be made in 48 hours" things.



open worldwide, prizes go out by paypal, or another way we agree on if paypal doesnt reach you. [buywhim.com/jam](http://buywhim.com/jam) has the details. happy to answer anything here
